claim_boundary.claim: causal five-link adaptation preserving the paper's suspension-point-acceleration swing-regulation idea

equivalent_swing_definition.suspension_point: causal MuJoCo position of the upper suspension point
equivalent_swing_definition.cutter_com: causal MuJoCo position of cutter body center of mass
equivalent_swing_definition.rates: causal time derivative from MuJoCo state/Jacobian, never future truth

preserved_core: suspension-point acceleration is the virtual input used to regulate equivalent load swing
cascade separation between swing regulation and attitude/inner actuation
paper-inspired local stability reasoning is retained as an adaptation rationale, not claimed as a proof for the five-link plant
adaptation_limits: only controller-specific x channel may be changed
R1R1 shared Y/Z task PD remains unchanged
same five-link MuJoCo plant, actuators, target, wind, terminal and safety gates
no extra camera, tension, slack-mode, obstacle, or payload sensor interface
no future wind or future target
